+"""Standalone copy of :func:`click.globals.resolve_color_default`.
+
+This module has no dependency on Click so it can be imported by file
+path without loading the package or its runtime initialization.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+from threading import local
+
+if t.TYPE_CHECKING:
+
+    class Context(t.Protocol):
+        color: bool | None
+
+
+__all__ = ["vendored_color_default", "vendored_color_default_variant"]
+
+_local = local()
+
+
+@t.overload
+def get_current_context(silent: t.Literal[False] = False) -> Context: ...
+
+
+@t.overload
+def get_current_context(silent: bool = ...) -> Context | None: ...
+
+
+def get_current_context(silent: bool = False) -> Context | None:
+    """Returns the current context from this module's local context
+    stack.
+
+    :param silent: if set to `True` the return value is `None` if no context
+                   is available.  The default behavior is to raise a
+                   :exc:`RuntimeError`.
+    """
+    try:
+        return t.cast("Context", _local.stack[-1])
+    except (AttributeError, IndexError) as e:
+        if not silent:
+            raise RuntimeError("There is no active click context.") from e
+
+    return None
+
+
+def push_context(ctx: Context) -> None:
+    """Pushes a new context to the current stack."""
+    _local.__dict__.setdefault("stack", []).append(ctx)
+
+
+def pop_context() -> None:
+    """Removes the top level from the stack."""
+    _local.stack.pop()
+
+
+def vendored_color_default(color: bool | None = None) -> bool | None:
+    """Internal helper to get the default value of the color flag.  If a
+    value is passed it's returned unchanged, otherwise it's looked up from
+    the current context.
+    """
+    if color is not None:
+        return color
+
+    ctx = get_current_context(silent=True)
+
+    if ctx is not None:
+        return ctx.color
+
+    return None
+
+
+def vendored_color_default_variant(color: bool | None = None) -> bool:
+    """Like :func:`vendored_color_default`, but a ``None`` result is
+    mapped to ``False``. ``True`` and ``False`` results are unchanged.
+    """
+    rv = vendored_color_default(color)
+
+    if rv is None:
+        return False
+
+    return rv

+import importlib.util
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import types
+
+import pytest
+
+MODULE_PATH = (
+    pathlib.Path(__file__).parent.parent / "src" / "standalone_wave6_color_default.py"
+)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def mod():
+    before = set(sys.modules)
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "standalone_wave6_color_default", MODULE_PATH
+    )
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    loaded = set(sys.modules) - before
+    assert not any(name == "click" or name.startswith("click.") for name in loaded)
+    yield module
+    module._local.__dict__.pop("stack", None)
+
+
+def _ctx(color):
+    return types.SimpleNamespace(color=color)
+
+
+def test_exports(mod):
+    assert mod.__all__ == ["vendored_color_default", "vendored_color_default_variant"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [True, False])
+def test_explicit_value_returned(mod, value):
+    mod.push_context(_ctx(not value))
+    assert mod.vendored_color_default(value) is value
+    assert mod.vendored_color_default_variant(value) is value
+
+
+def test_no_context_returns_none(mod):
+    assert mod.vendored_color_default() is None
+    assert mod.vendored_color_default_variant() is False
+
+
+def test_empty_stack_returns_none(mod):
+    mod.push_context(_ctx(True))
+    mod.pop_context()
+    assert mod._local.stack == []
+    assert mod.vendored_color_default() is None
+    assert mod.vendored_color_default_variant() is False
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("color", [True, False, None])
+def test_context_color(mod, color):
+    mod.push_context(_ctx(color))
+    assert mod.vendored_color_default() is color
+    assert mod.vendored_color_default_variant() is bool(color)
+
+
+def test_innermost_context_wins(mod):
+    mod.push_context(_ctx(True))
+    mod.push_context(_ctx(False))
+    assert mod.vendored_color_default() is False
+    mod.pop_context()
+    assert mod.vendored_color_default() is True
+
+
+def test_get_current_context_errors(mod):
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="no active click context"):
+        mod.get_current_context()
+    mod._local.stack = []
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError) as exc_info:
+        mod.get_current_context()
+    assert isinstance(exc_info.value.__cause__, IndexError)
+    assert mod.get_current_context(silent=True) is None
+
+
+def test_pop_without_stack_raises(mod):
+    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
+        mod.pop_context()
+
+
+def test_context_attribute_error_propagates(mod):
+    mod.push_context(object())
+    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
+        mod.vendored_color_default()
+    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
+        mod.vendored_color_default_variant()
+
+
+def test_stack_is_thread_local(mod):
+    import threading
+
+    mod.push_context(_ctx(True))
+    result = []
+    thread = threading.Thread(
+        target=lambda: result.append(mod.vendored_color_default())
+    )
+    thread.start()
+    thread.join()
+    assert result == [None]
+    assert mod.vendored_color_default() is True

Copied resolve_color_default verbatim as vendored_color_default plus local get_current_context/push_context/pop_context with a threading.local stack and a TYPE_CHECKING-only Context protocol; vendored_color_default_variant maps only a None result to False.
